## Done

Phases 0-6 of `plan.md` are built, and the Phase 7 evidence kit exists. The
portable custody core is nine modules with seven test suites
(`work/phase-0`); the login-gated application carries the five-stage loop -
harvest, source review and promotion, topics and pair relationships, standing
documents with revisions, and archive and reopen - plus the canonical web and
administrator export, across nine test suites (`work/phase-1-site/test`). The
2026-09-05 rehearsal connected all of it to a D1 snapshot store with
fresh-package R2 restore, added stale-selection and ownership guards,
per-attempt recovery staging, an 18-source synthetic practice fixture and a
public `/acceptance` curator checklist. In that rehearsal the hosted web and
administrator packages were byte-identical, and a fresh-site upload restored 18
sources, six narratives, and one document with two revisions with a
read-back-verified asset (`notes/2026-09-05-connected-workflow-rehearsal.md`).

## Waiting on others

Nothing is owed by a third party. Phase 7 requires a person other than the
implementer to correct AI proposals, author the accepted standing-document
revision, archive and reopen a narrative, and initiate the same export from the
web and from authenticated administrator action (`plan.md` Phase 7,
`test-plan.md` §4.7).

## Remaining work

Phase 7 is the only open phase, and it advances the stage. It needs a witnessed
five-stage sitting on a bounded, rights-safe source set - the fixture is still
synthetic - with operational time, storage, review effort, isolation findings,
recovery steps and scheduling reliability recorded, and that evidence compared
against the four deferred distribution topologies in `spec.md`. The evidence
template deliberately keeps the witness, the measurements, the package hash and
the live disposable restore pending rather than filling them from deterministic
tests.

## Optional later

`plan.md` §4 holds out unattended crawling or mailbox synchronization; public
collections, invitations, organization administration and concurrent editing;
autonomous acceptance of model proposals; cross-collection semantic search and
relationships; portable package signatures; a generalized graph query language;
and the production distribution choice itself, which stays open until the
representative-use evidence exists.
